quarterly_data.quarter: Huatian Technology investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: it received the China Securities Regulatory Commission's approval for the acquisition of Huayi Microelectronics on September 24, 2026 and is pushing ahead with closing; it expects its operating scale and profit to increase after the acquisition. Huayi Microelectronics had 2025 revenue of RMB 16.8 hundred million and net profit of RMB 0.79 hundred million, and H1 2026 revenue of RMB 10.67 hundred million and net profit of RMB 1.05 hundred million.
quarterly_data.figure: Huayi Microelectronics H1 2026 revenue RMB 10.67 hundred million, net profit RMB 1.05 hundred million; CSRC approval 09-24-2026
